title: Inkling Robotics Leaderboard data
description: Everything in this file is public. It carries only overall scores with their 95% intervals and coarse token buckets. Per-task scores, seeds, episode outputs and logs must never appear here, so unknown fields are rejected.

generated_at.description: When the publisher wrote this file (UTC).

entries.description: Every scored public submission, in any order. The site sorts and groups them. Exactly one entry has is_base true.

final.description: Present only after the finale reveal.

entries.description: One row per account (plus the base solution), best private score first.

account.description: GitHub login. Treated as untrusted text by the site.

percent.description: A success rate in percent (0 to 100), averaged over the 7 tasks.

commit_url.description: Link to the public record commit of the submission.

id.description: Submission id, unique in the file.

is_base.description: True for the base solution (the account is then the organisation account). Default false.

tokens_bucket.description: Tokens per episode, coarse: lt10k = under 10k, 10k-30k, gt30k = over 30k.

band.description: Rank band from the paired bootstrap on the private seeds; 1 is the first-place band.

runs.description: Private runs averaged into the score: 3 for the top 10, otherwise 1.

picks_source.description: explicit = chosen with bench pick; default = the 2 most recent submissions.

picks.description: The submissions that counted for this account.
